The harness re-derives the MUTATIONS on every run. Without this file nothing re-derives
the GUARDS — they would be demonstrated once, by hand, which is precisely the degradation
this mission diagnoses in #70's NFR-003. Each entry names the guard that must reject it;
being rejected by a DIFFERENT guard is a failure, because it means the guard under test
Every verdict the harness can emit must appear here as an expectRejectedBy — the script
asserts that set, so a new guard cannot ship without a self-check entry. Guards 6, 7, 8 and
guard 5's inverted arm previously had none, and guard 7 was disabled in selftest mode.
`subject` on every redTest entry (#74). Without it `inSubject()` in suite-selftest.mjs is
vacuously true and the probe matches its id in ANY file — so the moment a second test file
carried [SC-002], the guard-4 syntax-error probe stopped producing an ABSENT named test and
reported 'green' instead. Measured at 1 of 8 self-checks failing.
